stations.search.statement: SELECT id, name, region, level FROM stations WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR name LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR region = ?2) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ?3 = 'level' THEN level END DESC, CASE WHEN ?3 = 'name' THEN name END ASC, id ASC LIMIT min(coalesce(?4, 20), 100) OFFSET coalesce(?5, 0)

stations.after.statement: SELECT id, name, level FROM stations WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR id > ?1) ORDER BY id LIMIT 10

stations.summary.statement: SELECT region, count(*) AS stations, round(avg(level), 2) AS mean_level, max(level) AS peak FROM stations GROUP BY region ORDER BY region LIMIT 20

readings.record.statement: UPDATE stations SET level = ?2, updated_at = ?3 WHERE id = ?1
